svg.title: Schedules run on time
svg.desc: 1. Every 20 seconds the worker claims due schedules with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED. 2. The stored friendly command is translated at run time, so a model update from Tuya does not break it. 3. The result is stored, the next run is computed, and a one-time schedule switches itself off.
